# Private fixed-packet layout memo — correctness release, not for promotion

This component preserves an actual C20/C21 literal GEOS page, rather than
reconstructing layout from source. It is a private R34 slot-0 module; the
canonical startup, build, dispatcher and UI do not register or call it.
It is **slower than the current 53-asset renderer** on the measured 422-byte
document. No product performance or automatic navigation-reuse claim follows.

## Reproduce

From the SuperEditor directory:

```
python3 tests/test_cache_layout.py --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T021924007962Z/fixture
python3 tests/test_cache_layout_guards.py --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T021924007962Z/fixture
```

Only private outputs under `build/cache-layout*` are created. The test imports
the sealed R34 component through the real checked loader. It does not replace
the source, parser, renderer, font or packet consumer with host results.

## ABI and ownership

Owner 4 is checked before any caller-frame read. Opcodes 16/17 begin capture or
restore, 18 advances one bounded service, 19 cancels and 20 revokes. A=1/C=0 is
pending, A=0/C=0 is complete, A=2/C=0 is a safe miss; C=1 is an error. All DMA
transfers are at most 128 bytes. There is no new BSS, ZP or allocated REU bank.

The caller closes C20/R14 contexts first, supplies desired TOP24 at
`LM_TARGET` for RESTORE, and owns phase 8D00..9089 plus metadata 8880..89BF.
The existing text_ptr loan is used. The controller at 9134..9177 is untouched.
The module never paints VIC RAM. It never releases a foreign read lease.

**REVOKE is mandatory before any restore after cold initialization, resume,
fresh FE allocation or unproved retained-memory reuse.** Tokens/epochs can
repeat after cold clearing. This component has no canonical lifecycle hook
or independent persistent nonce; matching numbers alone do not authorize a
cross-session hit. REVOKE writes only the memo VALID byte at FE+0680.

## Stored data and authority

Metadata320 + header64 + N*(packet842 + outgoing64) + incoming128 is stored
in 20,864 bytes of declared FE row padding. At 22 rows this is 20,444 bytes,
leaving 420 bytes. Exact scatter spans are generated by `spans()` in the
verifier. They exclude primary packets, incoming CP0600..067F, SP2 authority
1600..167F, outgoing0700+i*0800, bitmap B200 onward and all later caches.

Every raw packet byte is preserved, including currently unused array tails
and gaps. Metadata, the entire payload and each record are CRC-protected.
Capture publishes memo VALID last. Restore verifies the whole payload before
the first primary VALID=0 write, then re-reads and verifies each record before
restoring it. Primary VALID=1 is published only after all guards and writes
complete. Cancellation after restore staging leaves primary VALID=0.

Keys include actual checked canonical source28, BC token/ticket/incarnation13,
settings64, capabilities, wrap, mode, presentation, exact TOP/PAN, fold
token/count/generation/visibility and typed-map bounds, FE logical/physical
ownership and epoch, native4800 CRC, and the published R21 size/CRC/slot.
ARMED/LOST/MUTATING/ACTIVE and queue state are checked at service boundaries.
Full source/provider guards are retained; no hardcoded physical bank is used.

The actual W_LOAD experiment changes full FS59 gap-representation fields
while leaving canonical28 and BC13 unchanged. A pending-edit flush changes
document generation and safely misses. This is measured identity behavior,
not a general source-rekey/edit-rebase implementation.

## Evidence and limits

The actual 422-byte producer has 19 rows and 17,406 raw payload bytes. The
restored consumer executes zero C20/C24/C25/C26 entries with C20 deliberately
unavailable, and matches independent 64,000-pixel/1,000-attribute oracles.
The test also records a same-input warm forced-full control. Capture cost is
reported separately from hit cost. Actual public POSITION/W_LOAD creates the
second viewport, but restoring/choosing TOP is an explicit component seam;
this is not a public automatic A→B→A implementation.

Refusal/cancel tests retain full 16 MiB outside exact declared writes, source,
history, clipboard, shim, VIC and foreign locks. They cover 22 actual native
rows, count161, folded pages, corruption, owner/type/provider/epoch/settings
changes, competing source/cache work, mid-flight revocation and REVOKE.

The CPU runner clock is unavailable: only instruction counts are reported,
not emulated cycles, IRQ latency or hardware timing. No native or integrated
stack/lifecycle claim is made. C21 has only four spare bytes in the base;
coarse admission/control relocation and real lifecycle revocation remain
integration work. The fixed842 format is not recommended for promotion.

The next bounded experiment is a separate COUNT-packed format with explicit
reconstruction of live fields. It must prove which bytes are non-live; it
must not silently normalize this release's exact-byte contract. A provisional
primary VALID=0, single-pass CRC restore is another unimplemented possibility
requiring every consumer/interleaving to honor unpublished primary packets.
